title: Fleur de Sea - Main House | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home:* Just a short walk or bike ride from Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* FREE seasonal tram service to the beach and pool* 4 Bikes Included!* Largest Community Pool in 30A!* 5 Private Balconies and Outdoor Living Spaces
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home:* Just a short walk or bike ride from Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* FREE seasonal tram service to the beach and pool* 4 Bikes Included!* Largest Community Pool in 30A!* 5 Private Balconies and Outdoor Living Spaces* Gas grill *Add the separate Carriage House for additional guests or extended family!* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceThis property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.Welcome to Fleur de Sea Main House, a light-filled beach retreat tucked along a peaceful nature trail between Rosemary and Alys. This updated three-story main home offers four bedrooms — each with a private en-suite bath — plus a half bath on the first floor. Maximum occupancy is 11 guests. The third-floor bunk room is an open space and best suited for children. Enjoy five private balconies and porches, a cobblestone patio with a rattan swing, gas grill and a garage game room with ping pong, darts, and beach storage. Inside features wood floors, crisp white interiors, abundant natural light, and French doors throughout. The open living area features coastal accents and a 70” Smart TV. The dining table comfortably seats eight, and the kitchen features stainless steel appliances, bar seating, and a convenient countertop ice maker. Wonderful family memories in the making at Fleur de Sea Main House!-Traveling with a larger group? The separate Fleur de Sea Carriage House may be available to add to your reservation, offering additional sleeping accommodations for extended family and friends. Please contact us for availability and pricing.-**Please Note: Unless the carriage house is included in your reservation, it may be occupied by other guests. Carriage house amenities, including the ping pong table and garage access are not available to guests staying in the main home only. Because the carriage house is a separate rental on the property, you may occasionally hear noise from other guests during your stay.**The Bed Setup: 1st Floor: King bedroom with en-suite bath 2nd Floor: Primary King suite with en-suite spa bath 2nd Floor: King bedroom with en-suite bath 3rd Floor: Twin-over-Full bunk room with sleeper sofa and en-suite bath We LOVE Snowbirds!Low Monthly Winter Rates Snowbird Season runs from January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Area Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Rosemary Beach and Aly's Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center with coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
